Quick-release awning hitches and brackets that let you take your awning off in seconds, so the cold, the wind and the snow never get the better of your gear.

Fast off, easy storage

From the roof to the wall in four moves

Fit it once. After that, the awning comes off whenever the weather or the road asks for it, and goes straight onto the wall at home.

1

Fit it once

Bolt the hitches to your awning. Triple-spine wing awnings use three points on 60 mm centres.

2

Lift it off

Quick release means no tools. Take the awning off the vehicle in seconds and carry it away.

3

Hang it up

Slide it onto the XD Wall Mount in the garage or workshop. Out of the sun and moisture, it stays put until the next trip.

4

Lock it on the road

The hitch has barrel locks built in, so the awning stays on the vehicle when you want it to.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Can I lock the awning to the wall mount?

Not with this bundle. The XD Wall Mount (9010) has no barrel locks fitted. The XD Lockable Wall Mount (9011) comes with locks, if you want to secure an accessory to a garage or workshop wall the way you would on your vehicle.

Which awnings does it work with?

Wing awnings with mounting points, including the 23Zero, Darche, Howling Moon and The Bush Company ranges, and many others. It also works with the Ostrich Wing 270 awnings, using the standard slider brackets that ship with them. In general, look for a track spacing of at least 100–120 mm; triple-spine wing awnings have each track at 60 mm centres, 120 mm between the upper and lower mounting points, and the third point in the centre.

My awning has wider spine spacing. Can I still use it?

Yes. The XD Multi-Awn Adaptor (9114, 9115), sold separately, extends compatibility to spine spacings of 135–150 mm, and lets the XD Hitch work with the 30 Second, Supa Peg, Outbound Shield 6 and Bushwakka Australia range.

How much weight can each mounting point carry?

Up to 20 kg per mounting point. With two mounting points, for example, the maximum is 40 kg.

Is there a warranty?

The XD Hitch comes with a 5-year warranty (conditions apply). Ask your authorised dealer for the full terms.

Where do I buy it in Europe?

From an authorised RacksBrax dealer in your country. They hold the stock and look after shipping, VAT and returns. Prices on this page are indicative, roughly converted from the Australian price list, and each dealer sets the final price.
